feeds.title: Cymed Blog
feeds.description: MicroSkin offers a level of comfort and security unmatched by any other product on the market Designed with an emphasis on comfort and durability. Cymed provides you with a variety of pouches for every type of ostomy. All are composed of Cryovak odor-proof material and have a waterproof comfort backing.

feeds.title: MyOstomy
feeds.description: At MyOstomy.ca, our purpose is simple: to help make living with an ostomy worry-free. MyOstomy.ca specializes in Ostomy, Hernia Supports, Wound & Skin, Scar Therapy, Home Healthcare, and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). We carry the most trusted brands including Coloplast, Convatec, Hollister, Salts, Marlen, Safe n Simple, and more. Explore our blog for ostomy-related resources, education, and tip & tricks.

feeds.title: Inner Good USA Blog
feeds.description: Inner Good is USA's modern online resource for people looking for high-quality medical products and advice for long-term health and wellness. We specialize in Ostomy Supplies, Wound Care, Continence, and Nutritional Supplements. Read the blogs and find articles that help individuals living with chronic illnesses navigate topics such as sex, health, well-being and life hacks.

feeds.title: Inner Good Canada Blog
feeds.description: Inner Good is Canada's modern online resource for people looking for high-quality medical products and advice for long-term health and wellness. We specialize in Ostomy Supplies, Wound Care, Continence, and Nutritional Supplements. Find articles about a range of topics that help Ostomates through numerous situations.

feeds.title: United Ostomy Associations of America News
feeds.description: United Ostomy Associations of America, Inc. (UOAA) is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization that supports, empowers, and advocates for people who have had or who will have ostomy or continent diversion surgery. UOAA promotes quality of life for people with ostomies and continent diversions through information, support, advocacy, and collaboration.

feeds.title: Respond News
feeds.description: Respond Healthcare provides award-winning prescription and dispensing home delivery and support services to the stoma and continence care community. Read the blogs to find the latest news and stories supporting people with Stomas and invisible diseases.

feeds.title: SIIL Ostomy Blog
feeds.description: SIIL Ostomy Line, fashion and accessories for ostomates, is a project that was born with great enthusiasm, love, and work, to meet the needs of all those who are looking for functional garments that allow them to feel attractive and confident.

feeds.title: Backcountry Ostomy Blog
feeds.description: Hi, my name's Charlotte. I'm on a mission to help ostomates (and the world) recognize that life doesn't have to be limited by an ostomy. Backcountry Ostomy is a space to empower ostomates to live an active lifestyle by providing resources through blog posts and social media. With Backcountry Ostomy, I also seek to educate rehab professionals. Through my personal experience and my work as an OT, I am able to provide a blend of current evidence-based research and creative problem-solving solutions for both ostomates and professionals.

feeds.title: More Than My Ostomy Blog
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Ellyn. I'm so glad you're here. This is a safe space for us to get real about what it looks like to look and feel our best as an ostomate! I have been dedicated to supporting and advocating for other women facing the same challenges of an ostomate as I am.

feeds.title: Better Health Blog » Living with an Ostomy
feeds.description: We strive to digitize and modernize the antiquated medical supplies industry. More than 80 million Americans use medical supplies in their homes on a regular basis. But getting access to these products can be challenging and costly. Read our blogs and learn everything you need to know about daily life with an ostomy.

feeds.title: Stoma Chameleon
feeds.description: Stoma Chameleon. Blogger, a fun and positive site aiming to inspire people who have suffered birth trauma and/or are living with a stoma. No graphically miserable stories or insta perfect pictures. Real, honest fun. Stoma Chameleon - change is life!

feeds.title: Tomas The Stoma Blog
feeds.description: My name is Clare I live in Nottingham and I have a permanent ileostomy due to IBD. I had my first surgery to remove the colon in April 2016, this was open surgery leaving me a scar from just above my belly button down to my pubic bone. This site has lots of information, but also my own ramblings, often with graphic images of wounds and stomas. My aim is to raise awareness of all things stoma and IBD ( inflammatory bowel disease) and to show the world that life doesn't have to end after a traumatic event, it just changes.
